description: Planes de Aforo de Tráfico en Castilla-La Mancha is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Comunidad Autónoma de Castilla-La Mancha. Characteristics, behavior and evolution of traffic on the road network of the community of Castilla-La Mancha. The main objective of the work is to obtain different traffic parameters for use in the realization of planning studies, projects and operation of the road network. Coverage: Comunidad Autónoma de Castilla-La Mancha. The portal shows the English title as "Traffic Capacity Plans in Castile-La Mancha" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Comunidad Autónoma de Castilla-La Mancha. Its keywords include Tráfico, Aforo tráfico, Intensidad, IMD. The listing shows 3 download or service links in SHEET, MS-EXCEL. The listing shows 2026-03-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/es/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
